description: This file is a shell script used for configuring and testing Git repository behaviors, particularly related to user email and name settings. It sets up various test cases to verify the behavior of Git under different configuration scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success when running a provided shell commands block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and reports an error if it does not.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a Git configuration variable for the test repository.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output, reporting differences.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables or configs to prevent carry-over effects between tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.
